summary: Lithium Argentina AG filed a Form 6-K (foreign private issuer current report, US equivalent of a routine current report) attaching a 2026 Cauchari-Olaroz S-K 1300 technical report effective September 15, 2026, plus six qualified-person consents. The filing is a disclosure of mineral resource/reserve and technical study content for the Argentine brine project, not a transaction. No stake, price, premium, or closing date is stated. Watch for technical-report and resource updates and any related project or corporate developments rather than deal-arbitrage dynamics.
